blockers: No RGS integration in the production build: zero occurrences of wallet/authenticate, wallet/play, wallet/end-round, rgs_url, sessionID, bet/replay or payoutMultiplier across all 889 files of dist/. src/stake/rgs.ts has no importer and is tree-shaken out. The game deals outcomes from a client-side RNG (SlotApp.svelte:188) and pays from a demo wallet (SlotApp.svelte:225, createDemoFlightRgs at :1709). Verified live: 22 spins moved the balance $1,000.00 to $1,018.50 with zero network traffic beyond static assets. Checklist items 20-37 and 73-77 unreachable; no replay implementation exists at all.

setCurrency() and setSocial() have zero call sites, so the build runs only in USD and social mode can never arm. socialLabel is absent from dist entirely; ?social=true renders 'STAKE', 'Pay' and 'Buy' unchanged. There is no i18n, so ?lang=de renders English. Checklist items 16-19 (Balance/Bet decimals in KWD and JPY) cannot be tested because the build will not run in those currencies; items 2-15 and 39-40 fail.

The disclaimer carries 1 of Stake's 7 required points (MenuModal.svelte:1237-1243). Missing: internet requirement, disconnection recovery, expected return over many plays, display accuracy, copyright. The payout-source point states the opposite of the requirement - 'Every spin's outcome is drawn from the game's random source at the moment SPIN is pressed' against 'Winnings are settled according to the amount received from the Remote Game Server and not from events within the web browser'. approval-disclaimer.svx:18 makes this an explicit approval gate.
findings: Undisclosed 1.5x win floor voids advertised paytable wins. paytable.ts:629 WIN_FLOOR = 1.5, applied at evaluate.ts:257, with the winning lines suppressed at :258. At a $1.00 stake the line bet is $0.025, so 3-of-a-kind on six of the eight paying symbols and 4-of-a-kind on three of them pay zero. Driven through the shipped evaluator: carrot x3 (paytable $0.25) and carrot x4 ($0.50) both settle at $0.00. My own 2,000,000-spin run at this commit: line hit rate 20.3697%, paid hit rate 9.9246% - 51.3% of winning spins pay nothing. Disclosure was deliberately removed, MenuModal.svelte:684-690.

Probability and hit-rate numbers throughout player copy (checklist 57): 'about 1 spin in 451', 'once in 1,048,576 spins', 'worth about 94.6x your stake', '1 in 4 spins instead of 1 in 451', '3x as often', 'drills on 5.3% of rounds', 'DIGS 90% OF ROUNDS', 'one spin in thirty to one in ten'.

The Settings tab tells the player 'This game has no audio yet' (MenuModal.svelte:1206, unconditional, present in dist/assets/slotapp-jgqxp9m2.js). Measured in the built game: 13 buffers decoded, 37 buffer sources started across six spins, music element playing, peak amplitudes 0.5008 and 0.1773. The claim is false.

The entire bonus world and every feature scene are silent. Zero playSfx/scheduleSfx/startLoop/new Audio in FelixFlight.svelte, DuelScene.svelte, ShotScene.svelte, EggFx.svelte, TractorWipe.svelte, FsFrame.svelte, FreeSpinTracker.svelte, AubergineFall.svelte, BuyPanel.svelte and RoundGate.svelte. No cue for free-spins entry, exit, retrigger, the duel, the shot, the eggs, the tractor wipe, the buy confirm, or any part of Felix's Flight.

Dev tooling ships in the production build (checklist 88). ?force-event opens a 21-entry force panel against the built artefact (ForcePanel.svelte:49-56, mounted unconditionally at SlotApp.svelte:2762). ?build-ew, ?build-egg, ?build-fs and ?type mount rig builders from main.ts:70-79. dist/impact-preview/, dist/wild-preview/ and dist/felixs-flight/ ship as routes.

Felix's Flight launch prices invisible at 1280x720. .fl__body has overflow:auto with its bottom edge at y=570; the three price values sit at y=571-601 with the bet bar painted over them. Reproduced only at 1280x720; correct at 1366x768, 1280x800 and 1920x1080. Checklist 51.

Displayed RTP is a config label, not the pack. Every surface reads 96.50% from pct(GAME.targetRtp[0]) (MenuModal.svelte:529, 556, 567, 573); npm run sim at this commit prints the engine's own exact TOTAL 96.3984%. Checklist 101.
Spacebar is not bound to bet (checklist 41). Space with the canvas focused leaves the balance unchanged after six seconds. Items 42 and 43 pass only because the key does nothing.

No UI guide in the rules (checklist 54, reviewer item 6.5), and the rules name 'The BUY button on the control bar' when the control is an unlabelled studio-paw arch (ControlBar.svelte:271-274, barLayout.ts:117).

Refresh mid-spin loses the round and returns to the intro. No browser dialog and zero beforeunload handlers, so item 34 is clean, but there is no resume because no round is booked. Checklist 32, 33, 35.
Base-game non-zero hit rate is 1 in 10.1 (9.9246% measured), outside the 1-in-3-to-1-in-8 guidance though inside the 1-in-20 reject line. Caused by the win floor. Checklist 98.

Minor: console.log x6 and console.warn x17 in production chunks (item 63); assets/audio/reel_stop_thud.mp3 is byte-identical (md5 c15f84267fb73a5143d250959df758a5) to Tiki Taka Madness's reel-stop cut; a source folder named 'slots assets' sits at the repo root outside filename-law's dist-only sweep.
lift: Wire the RGS client you have already written. Replace the demo wallet in SlotApp.svelte with createRgsClient(readStakeLaunch()) and drive setCurrency() and setSocial() from that authenticate response. src/stake/rgs.ts is finished and better than most shipped clients - bounded retry, play opted out of resend, an authenticate probe for the ambiguous timeout, both jurisdiction field placements, bet levels clamped to minBet/maxBet - it is simply not plugged in. That one wire turns a demo into a game, makes the KWD and JPY decimal rules testable, arms the social scrub that currently ships nowhere, and gives replay something to replay.
